info.name: F5 Load Balancer F5 BIG-IP Application Services 3 Extension (AS3) Config API
F5 Load Balancer List original device configurations

items.docs: Retrieves the original configurations for all devices managed by Declarative Onboarding before any DO modifications were applied.

info.name: F5 Load Balancer Get original configuration for a device

params.name: machineId
params.description: The machine ID of the BIG-IP device whose original configuration to retrieve.

items.docs: Retrieves the original configuration for a specific device identified by its machine ID, as it existed before Declarative Onboarding modifications.
